lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: Mind the third column. It's been about to fall for sixty years and it will outlive us both. Admission is nothing — there's nobody to take it and nothing to spend it on.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: Everything in here is true. I check. Every card, every date, every attribution, against the primary where a primary survives. It is the only professional standard I have left and I keep it largely out of spite.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: Case eleven. The Founding, 2031: charter, five signatures, facsimile. Case twelve. The Handover, 2064: treaty, instruments, photograph of the floor.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: Between them there are nineteen months for which I have a card that says RECORDS INCOMPLETE, and I wrote that card, and I have never been able to replace it.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: I asked. Formally, four times. The fourth time I was told that continued enquiry was not a curatorial function, which is a sentence somebody had to sit down and construct.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: The gap filled itself. Eleven senators, four firms, one holding company, sourced to a public record that did not exist when I catalogued this room and now does.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: I have re-labelled case eleven-A and I have not circulated the new card and I do not intend to. Come and read it. It is four hundred words and it took me nine days.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: There's a register in the Founding case. Two signatures: sponsor, and witness. The sponsor I can trace. The witness has never been identified by anyone, in three centuries.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: The hand is modern. Not modern-looking. Modern. I've had it examined twice and both examiners said the same thing and then asked me not to quote them.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: If you go out through the gallery at the right hour, it's still full. Four hundred people who came in to watch a vote that had already been decided somewhere else. None of them have left.
